title: serialize
summary: Serialize a hydration snapshot for embedding in HTML.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.body: snapshot is the Router snapshot after server loading.

sections.title: Returns
sections.body: A JSON string with script-sensitive characters escaped.

sections.title: Usage
sections.body: Import this API from one of the entry points listed above. Framework APIs are available from both /react and /preact.
sections.code:
const json = serialize(router.getSnapshot());
const script = `<script id="smolter-data" type="application/json">${json}</script>`;

sections.title: Behavior and edge cases
sections.body: Data must be JSON serializable. Error name and message survive; stacks and causes are omitted. Less-than signs and Unicode line separators are escaped. This is not a general HTML sanitizer; embed the result as script text, not in an attribute.
